opening.argument: The speaker describes depositing money into OneCoin, putting tokens through a mining process, and then presenting a balance of 10,420 coins after 52 days. He also attributes €5,171 in bonuses to sponsoring others and says, “technically I've already got my Money back from what I put in.” This is a personal earnings pitch built around recruitment commissions: the dashboard and testimony frame sponsorship bonuses as recovering the initial contribution, while the description invites viewers to join his “POWER LEG.”
